describe: A real map in a rect (`x`, `y`, `w`, `h`) with one place lit up. The map picture and the place outlines come from the manifest's `geo` section (authoring/expander/geo.mjs, built from Natural Earth), never from the model: write `geo` and leave the art role `map` and the geo_* functions to it. The game supplies `map_focus()` (int): the index into the `geo` places to light up, or -1 for none. For example `get_or(order, qi, -1)` to show the asked country, or `if locked then get_or(order, qi, -1) else -1` to show it only after the answer. The lit place is filled with $accent and gets a pulsing ring at its label point, so small countries still show. `geo_place_at(p)` (p: a canvas vec2, such as a tap's pointer) gives the index of the game's place whose outline contains p, or -1: use it for tap-the-country games. Draws nothing interactive; add map_pin (or your own transparent rect with on_tap) for taps.

map.describe: The map picture, made by the geo step from Natural Earth outlines. Don't draw it yourself.

_cross.body: if (a.y > p.y) == (b.y > p.y) then false else p.x < (b.x - a.x) * (p.y - a.y) / (b.y - a.y) + a.x

_inside.body: fold(range(len(ring)), false, (acc, i) => if _cross(p, get_or(ring, i, vec(0.0, 0.0)), get_or(ring, (i + len(ring) - 1) % len(ring), vec(0.0, 0.0))) then not acc else acc)

geo_place_at.body: fold(range(len(geo_ring_place())), -1, (acc, r) => if acc < 0 and _inside(vec(p.x - @x, p.y - @y), get_or(geo_rings(), r, [])) then get_or(geo_ring_place(), r, -1) else acc)
